page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with an AMD EPYC 9T25 processor operating at 2.7 GHz based on the x86_64 architecture. Compute capacity is delivered through 4 dedicated vCPUs accompanied by 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

Hardware provisions do not include local disk storage, requiring deployments to utilize attached network block storage for persistent filesystems and application data. Network throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps, and the configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include discrete GPU acceleration hardware.

The 1:4 allocation profile provides predictable compute resource density without incurring the overhead of excessive memory provisioning or specialized accelerator silicon. The technical profile is aligned with mainstream enterprise workloads, including web application servers, containerized microservice tiers, continuous integration runners, and moderate relational databases backed by attached storage volumes.
